basis: The Cour des comptes report S2023-1040 states the administrative public establishment form, the 2010 decree, the presidential decree appointment on the culture minister's proposal and the civil servant and contract staff (pages 11, 14 and 15 and section 1.3), and the establishment's own page confirms the form and ministry oversight.

governance.parent: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Culture (French Polynesia)

basis: The Lexpol entry of the French Polynesia government lists the museum as an administrative public establishment created by deliberation no. 80-112 of 1980, organised by arrêté no. 1619 CM of 2000, with the culture ministry as supervising ministry.
The About page (web.archive.org copy of cca.ge) describes the centre as an independent, non-profit institution.
Article 1 point 6 of the statute approved by the education, science, culture and sports minister's order no. 110/n of 18 June 2019 gives the form as a legal entity of public law.
The museum page says TPMM was founded in 2017 as a non-governmental, not-for-profit organization.

The Berlin museum foundations law (MusStG, 2005 text) sections 1, 2, 6 and 9 and the 1999 statute sections 3 and 9 state the public-law foundation, the Senate appointment of the director, the Stiftungsrat budget decision, the civil servant and BAT staff and the Rechnungshof audit right, and the museum's foundation page lists both texts.
The About us page calls C/O Berlin a charitable foundation that grew from the private initiative of three founders.
The museum's imprint names the operator as DDR Museum Berlin GmbH with a commercial register number at the Berlin-Charlottenburg District Court.
